svg.title: My track breaks the champion
svg.text: Paperclip, opened from its share link · the seed 3, generation 80 champion
cyan: lap 1, 14.17 s. In the hairpin (it turns right) it slows to 7 px/s, almost a stop, and creeps round
pink: lap 2. Same hairpin: it stops dead at 22.48 s, keeps holding BRAKE (from a standstill that means reverse),
and backs into the wall at 23.00 s. It never finishes lap 2.
